scope: Parameterized heat/opacity screen for a uniform supported membrane facing a renewable absorber. Not material lifetime qualification.

electron_bookkeeping.scope: Electron kinetic energy is a component-scale diagnostic, not an extra addition to hydrodynamic K. Actual ion charge and sheath potential require plasma transport. Recombination radiation or carried ionization energy must not be counted twice.

assumptions.cp_scope: Constant 1000J/kg/K sensitivity. Large deltaT values are sensible-heat equivalents; phase changes and decomposition occur first.
assumptions.k_scope: Silica k1.3 is room-temperature bulk data. Carbon and BN lateral100/through2 and SiC50 are controlled material scenarios, not hot irradiated film qualifications.
assumptions.photon_scope: NIST bulk coefficients. Mass-fraction mu additive; approximate mu_en additive. Fluence partition neglects secondary transport. No extrapolation below1keV.
assumptions.electron_retention: Rows show eta_retained=1. Linear scale all photon temperature and energy results by eta=.1,.01 as sensitivities. Secondary electrons arriving from the absorber are extra; electrostatic self-charging can suppress net escape.
assumptions.flash: Insulated faces, exponential primary deposition, Fourier conduction, fixed properties. No phase change, lateral supports or radiation. Actual radial-ray pulse bins; finite-angle broadening unresolved.
assumptions.cooling: Conductive sink lines assumed isothermal. Lateral L uses strip solution qL²/(8kd); ignores contact resistance, support heat and coolant limitations.
assumptions.ion_scope: Generic fractions are sensitivities. Historical scaled-peak diagnostics are preserved here. Exact timed stopping peaks are now available and used by mechanics.py. Projectile energy removal requires an independent local heat-retention model.
assumptions.cavity: Uniform closed sphere; no steady radiative heat removal to central vacuum. Opaque inward radiation is returned. Semitransparent gray examples face a black exterior bath.

radiation_upper_scope: Two black faces during the microsecond flash, no incoming photons; only an absolute local upper bound. Whole-shell steady rejection is limited by the actual outward sink.
